limitations: Credentials, raw prompts, machine paths, Session IDs, Run IDs, API keys, and raw host logs are intentionally excluded.
Usage and cost fields remain disabled until their provider semantics are independently verified.
Grok 1.x rejects non-empty additionalDirectories on session/resume; Rovai therefore sends an empty array and verifies real post-resume product behavior.
Compaction detection remains best-effort and fail-closed; the Windows qualification did not re-run the acceptance-only debug-arm compaction smoke.
Grok ignores ACP Session mcpServers; External MCP therefore uses a private process plugin-dir and rotates Host compatibility when the full server set changes.
Account cached-token authentication was not exercised because this host has no existing Grok login.

The MiniMax BYOK provider intermittently emitted empty Tool names and once emitted a malformed streaming usage chunk; Rovai/Grok failed closed, and the unchanged acceptance commands were required to pass cleanly on bounded reruns.

The packaged-App planned-shutdown run used the debug-only local Windows qualification override because Registry promotion is downstream of this evidence; the same base-revision Core and Runtime wire were exercised.
macOS x64 remains not qualified until its own target-host evidence is recorded.
